author: Cornelius Kibelka from Berlin, Germany
attribution: Photo: Cornelius Kibelka from Berlin, Germany, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cani_Comercial_Lda_sign,_Angoche_(36902689862).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Peeling, rusted script letters along a balcony fascia, Angoche. The first letter has a spur at lower right and differs from the 'C' of 'Comercial', so it reads 'Gani'; the Commons title spells it 'Cani'. A clover logo panel at far left is cut off. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Cornelius Kibelka from Berlin, Germany
attribution: Photo: Cornelius Kibelka from Berlin, Germany, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Angoche_city_sign_(36931500561).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow-green hotel board on a pole in a traffic island, Angoche (Nampula). Only the title is legible at 1600 px; the small description, address ('Avenida da Liberdade, Angoche') and phone lines are not reliably readable. Distractors: the white 'GUEST HOUSE HESADA' board below and the yellow cut-out stencil town sign 'ANGOCHE' on the bench (stencil letters, the N and H render as solid blocks), plus a partly hidden 'SEJA BEM VINDO' bench. Alternative query: 'Angoche' (place). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
